BiblicalUsage: Hazelelponi was the sister of Jezreel, Ishma, and Idbash, sons of Etam in the line of Judah. She is named once, in the middle of a genealogy, as the sister among the brothers. Her name carries the word for shade in it — a daughter remembered by name in a list of men.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the sisters in the genealogies are named on purpose, and Hazelelponi is one of them. God keeps the daughters in the record alongside the sons.
